messages:
jessica: FYI getting alerts — sudden spike of 504/timeouts on hosted inference API (/v1/generate) in us-west-2 starting ~12:07 UTC. Multiple customers reporting timeouts and errors. Opening war room.

matt-oncall: looking now. Nginx proxy error rate climbing, connection_queue length high on gateway nodes. Upstream worker errors show a bunch of 502/504 from inference pool-A. Traffic ~2x baseline for last 10m. Can we failover to eu-west while we triage? :thinking_face:

cheng: I'm seeing KV cache stall anomalies on pool-A. kv_cache_ops latency jumped to ~2.1s and cache_miss spiked 12x. Batcher latencies also increased which causes upstream timeouts. Trying a soft-restart of batcher group on pool-A to drain outstanding requests.

support-dave: Customer Impact: acme-inc and two other mid-market accounts reported 504s and some billing retries. Logged support tickets: #INT-987, #INT-988. Messaging customers with status and temporary mitigation: reduce concurrency and add client backoff. Need a decision about retroactive billing credits if requests were charged but errored.

matt-oncall: Initiating traffic steering: shifting 30% of new sessions away from pool-A to pool-B and eu-west. Also enabling tighter circuit-breaker on gateway route for /v1/generate so upstream failures short-circuit sooner.

incident-bot: rollback: ingress-edge v2.9.1 -> v2.9.0 rollback started by matt-oncall. CI/CD job 78921 triggered.

rachel: Confirmed: after rollback and batcher soft-restart, 5xx rate dropped from 8% -> 0.7% in ~6m. Latency for short requests back to normal. KV cache latency still slightly elevated but decreasing.

cheng: Quick root cause hypothesis: intermittent KV storage client GC pause + a batching race in batcher that amplifies tail latency under load. When kv client blocks, batcher batches grow and backpressure causes gateway timeouts. Repro steps I used locally: load generator 300r/s targeting pool-A, throttle KV client threads to simulate GC pause, observe queue growth + 504s.

matt-oncall: Triage notes: no sign of network partitions, CPU on inference nodes normal, but Go runtime GC/pause indicators on kv client show spikes. We need a perf regression review for kv client changes in last deploy (v2.9.1). Marking as rollback-successful for now.

jessica: Action items (post-incident):
- [ ] cheng: create minimal repro harness + unit test to simulate kv pause + batcher behavior (owner: cheng) — due EOD tomorrow
- [ ] eng-runtime: add timeout & retry around kv client ops and make async KV fetch fallback (owner: eng-runtime team) — due next sprint
- [ ] matt-oncall: tune gateway circuit-breaker thresholds and add automatic regional failover policy (owner: matt-oncall) — due 3 days
- [ ] support-dave: customer communications + billing credit playbook drafted (owner: support-dave) — due today
- [ ] rachel: add synthetic canary that exercises short tail latency at low QPS (owner: rachel) — due next week
- [ ] infra: add metrics alert for kv_cache_miss and kv_client_gc_pause (owner: infra) — due 2 days

anil: I'll take ownership of the postmortem write-up and coordinate a blameless incident review. I'll also open the PR to revert the kv-client change if the code review shows a regression.

support-dave: For customers: sent initial status update and offered to credit errored requests until we confirm billing postmortem. Will follow up once we know scope.

rachel: Note — observed one noisy tenant that hit extreme concurrency and amplified the pool-A problem. We should consider per-tenant rate-limits on new sessions as a safety valve.

cheng: Pushed a short-term patch to batcher to cap batch size under high KV latencies (non-blocking). Will monitor.

matt-oncall: Monitoring green across regions. Keeping war room open for 30m for validation, then will close if stable.

jessica: Great work all. Please post postmortem link and owners in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: War room closed by matt-oncall, summary: rollback + batcher soft-restart + traffic steering reduced 5xx. Created incident ticket INC-2026-155.

anil: Postmortem draft link: https://redwood-internal/pm/INC-2026-155/postmortem (will fill in details).
